summary: Tested must_change_password flow end-to-end. All 6 backend pytest tests pass and all frontend flows verified via Playwright. Worker with must_change_password=true sees forced password change screen (ShieldCheck icon, name/email, new+confirm fields, 'Postavi lozinku' button); URL stays at /login; mismatch shows 'Lozinke se ne poklapaju' and disables submit; short password (<6) disables submit; successful change updates DB (must_change_password=false, hash updated) and redirects to /beauty-studio-bor/admin. ProtectedRoute correctly redirects to /login when must_change_password=true. Admin login unaffected. GET /api/auth/me returns must_change_password field. Worker restored to must_change_password=false with Worker123! after tests.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_routes.py change-password does not verify current/old password before allowing change — acceptable for temporary-password flow, but if this endpoint is reused later for user-initiated password changes it should require the old password.

AdminLogin.jsx: 'Postavi lozinku' button is disabled when passwords don't match, but the toast in handleChangePassword for mismatch is unreachable (button disabled prevents submit). Not a bug, just dead code.
ProtectedRoute redirects must_change_password users to /login (correct), but there is no explicit toast/message telling them why they were bounced — minor UX nit.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily set worker@salon.com must_change_password=true during testing; RESTORED to false with Worker123! after tests completed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Worker credentials worker@salon.com / Worker123! with must_change_password=false. To retest, use pymongo to set must_change_password=true and re-hash Worker123!. Backend tests are self-contained (fixture flips flag then restores).
